_readme: Seed for skymp5-backend/data/faction-whitelist.json. Copy it there only while that file is missing or has no assignments.
Rank order 0 is the leader. appoints lists the rank ids a holder may invite into, act on and demote to; promotes (up to), demotes (holders of) and removes follow appoints until a rank sets its own.
permission is always the rank id with dots. The leader may also promote, demote, set and remove anyone below it. issuesUniform lets a rank hand out the faction uniform; capacity null means open.
Optional rank flags: invites (default true), managesProperty (default true for a hold's jarl and steward), factionAccess (default true).
uniform entries are { "item": "13ed9:Skyrim.esm" or "0x00013ED9", "count": 1 }; a rank uniform replaces the faction one.
Names, caps, ladders, rank lists and flags are edited in the dashboard Factions view or the Server Manager Factions tab; uniforms in the dashboard Factions view.
